# Repository description and topics

Prepared locally for the repository's **About** section. Apply these values on
GitHub only after the maintainer authorizes the update.

## Description

PC game streaming from VibeShine or Sunshine to Samsung Tizen TVs, with a controller-first library, Wake-on-LAN and optional TV-local session diagnostics.

## Homepage

GitHub Pages is prepared locally and has not been activated. After publication
and URL verification, the expected default project address is:

```text
https://samirmartins.github.io/vibelight-tizen/
```

This is a planned value, not a live-site claim. The guide starts in English and
offers Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish. Until hosting is active, the README
keeps local HTML/source links and the Markdown installation fallback.
